notes:
ScreenTale 1.0.3 improves upgrading older recordings, Dock behavior and license renewal.

- Upgrading an older recording now places the upgraded copy at the top of Recents with an "(Upgraded)" suffix, without asking where to save it. The original recording stays unchanged.
- Older recordings that still need an upgrade show a yellow warning icon next to their name in the Library.
- Opening ScreenTale no longer shows a second, bouncing ScreenTale icon in the Dock.
- A license key activated on this Mac now renews correctly while you are signed in to your ScreenTale account, so clean exports and updates continue without interruption.
